sentences.en: You want to have a finger in every pie, don't you?
sentences.zh: 你是不是想插手每件事？

sentences.en: "Will you have another slice of pie?" "Yes, please."
sentences.zh: "再来一块馅饼怎么样？" "好的，请来一块。"

sentences.en: No one bakes a finer apple pie than Emily.
sentences.zh: 艾米丽做的苹果派最好吃。

senses.zh: (西点)馅饼，派，杂乱，喜鹊，爱说话的人，饼图
